description: Three Ellsworth-Kelly-style negative-space regions, each filled by a nalee space-filling walker; the dividing edges lerp between keyframes so the fields regrow over time
notable: Clip polygons animate frame-to-frame and the nalee walkers regrow into the new domain each step

description: A single off-center rectangular region filled edge-to-edge by nalee space-filling walkers over a flat clrs ground
A central rectangle packed with nalee walkers in the infinite-pipe path style, using found-photo palettes (bless/carmen)
notable: Uses nalee's infinitePipeStyle for a woven-pipe texture instead of solid fill

description: A vertical band splits the canvas into three regions, each filled by nalee walkers in two foreground colors over a flat clrs ground
Two vertical edges slide horizontally between keyframes, resizing three nalee-filled regions that regrow into the shifting band on a near-black ground
A beveled window frame enclosing a grille of thin mullions with alternating dots and diamonds and small woven triangle motifs, atkinson-dithered
notable: Khidki means window; frame drawn with 45-degree beveled edges and reshuffles its subtractive palette each frame

description: Horizontal bands each seeded with points, k-means clustered and convex-hulled into overlapping polygons that reveal progressively, one flat subtractive color per band
notable: k-means picks the least-dense cluster each pass, peeling hulls off a point cloud

description: Variant of layered-slashes where every convex-hull polygon takes its own generated color, stacking many-hued overlapping blobs across horizontal bands
Interactive electric-field simulation: draggable point charges with a grid of color-coded field arrows and streamline paths traced through the vector field, on black
notable: Port of a p5 electric-field toy with its own minimal Complex class; keys add/remove charges and F traces streamlines

description: Procedural street-map: poisson-disk seeds grow bidirectional line segments that stop on intersection, parallel-street cleanup passes, rendered black on white
The growing street-map system clipped to a rectangle that slides across the canvas, with green clip boundary and red clipped segments over a random palette
notable: Reads as a work-in-progress test: clip window and clipped output drawn as debug overlays

description: Point cloud k-means-clustered into convex-hull regions, each filled by its own scaled street-map system and clipped to the hull, colored by segment length
notable: Nested composition: hull regions define districts, each with its own street density mapped from area

description: Sidewinder maze with BFS distance from start; cells fill in distance-band color order while unlinked walls stroke over top, animated band by band
notable: Based on jwolondon's Observable maze notebooks; sidewinder + breadth-first distance grid is the shared basis for the whole maze-distance series

description: Maze BFS distance field rendered as monospace glyphs, one symbol per distance band, each cell animating through a letter-shuffle reveal from a dot
notable: Cells scramble through random symbols before settling, like a departure-board flip

description: Maze distance field as ascii glyphs where each distance band draws from its own character set (digits, letters, box-drawing), on albers/mindful palettes
notable: Distinct glyph vocabulary per distance ring instead of one symbol

description: Maze distance field as block and box-drawing glyphs with a wider color count, cells letter-shuffling in from albers/mindful/subtractive palettes
Coarse 6x6 maze with distance-banded cells filled as rough.js multi-angle cross-hatch, giving a hand-drawn hatched look on a warm fixed palette
notable: rough.js cross-hatch fill at four hachure angles per cell for a sketchy weave; palette from an Alex Cristache tweet

description: Rough.js cross-hatched maze-distance cells passed through atkinson dithering, on albers/mindful palettes
notable: Combines hand-drawn hatch fill with a downscale-and-dither pass

description: Maze BFS distance field with cells colored by band then run through atkinson dithering for a retro halftone finish over a generated ramp
Maze distance field rendered in double-line box-drawing glyphs, each distance band a color, cells shuffling in through block characters
Maze distance field drawn as shaded-block glyphs in the jgs7 pixel font, distance-banded colors from a chromotome palette, cells shuffling in
A retro game-cartridge frame (SSAM-JS logo, MEMORY LEAK 64 label, ROM version) enclosing a pixel grid-stairs pattern plus cluster growth, with scanlines
notable: Frames a grid-stairs + cluster-growth artwork as a fake NES cartridge, complete with masked label and scanline overlay

description: Rotating ellipses swept around a pulsing ring, alternating two colors and clipped left/right at the seam to fake a twisting Mobius-band illusion
notable: Left half draws to 360 degrees and right half to 540, so the overlap seam reads as a twist

description: A 20x20 tile grid where cells fill only when their index is divisible by the current frame number, producing shifting modulo interference patterns
notable: Divisor is the frame counter itself, so the sparse pattern densifies then thins as frames advance
